André Luiz Berbett Pinheiro Lopes — a Brazilian content creator known online as Dedeco — died on Wednesday, his wife announced. He was 33.
“You went to live with God in heaven,” wrote Lopes’s wife, Fernanda Leite, in an emotional translated post on Oct. 28. “My heart bleeds because I won’t be able to come home from work and hug you anymore.”
Lopes was known by over 1 million followers across his Instagram , YouTube and Twitch accounts for commenting on and playing esports soccer. His YouTube account shared near-daily videos until his final upload on Oct. 26.
In her tribute, Leite called her late husband the “most generous, kind, gentle, loving man in the world.” The pair tied the knot on Sept. 7, roughly three years after they started dating, and had announced that they were expecting their first child weeks before Lopes’s death.
“I won’t be able to wake you up, go into your studio and kiss you while you edit your videos,” wrote Leite. “But one thing you can be sure of: your son will know how great you were and how much you loved and dreamed of him. He will know your immensity. He will know how loved and dreamed of him. I love you forever.”
In a follow-up post on Oct. 30, Leite opened up about the outpouring of love she had received in the wake of the tragic news.
“I want to thank all the messages of affection, those who could, present and say the last goodbye to the most beautiful man in the world,” she wrote on Instagram.
“I’m trying to process that he won’t have anymore, because at this moment he rests in the arms of God, there are no worries, no tears, no pain!” added Leite. “I know a lot of you know Dedeco, the talented guy, big hearted and funny. I lived with Andre, a man who was far beyond the dedication — much bigger.”
Added the grieving wife: “Those who can, pray for us, for the whole family, because Andre Luiz was our love, our safe harbor. There is no family at this moment that is not shaken.”
